title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: Working Student / Werkstudent — Applied AI - Software Engineering
description:
The Role

You’ll help build real products across the software lifecycle: understand the problem → design → implement → release → improve. You’ll take ownership of well-defined tasks and features, with guidance, code reviews, and feedback from experienced engineers.

You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and design, and join customer conversations to understand requirements and share progress. We value curiosity, systems thinking, and a practical approach to turning ideas into working software.

You don’t need to know our entire stack. Bring solid foundations, some hands-on experience, and the motivation to learn by building.

What You’ll Do

  • Build with AI: use generative tools, work with our reusable components, and help test and evaluate AI-powered features.
  • Contribute to engineering decisions: explore solutions, discuss trade-offs with the team, and implement practical approaches.
  • Ship useful features: work with product and design to turn requirements into manageable tasks and working software.
  • Work across the stack: contribute to services, APIs, data pipelines, and frontends, depending on your strengths and the project.
  • Build with quality in mind: write maintainable code, test your changes, and help improve reliability and performance with support from the team.
  • Collaborate with clients: join discussions, help clarify requirements, demo your work, and incorporate feedback alongside experienced teammates.
  • Communicate clearly: document your work, ask questions early, and keep the team informed about progress and blockers.

Required Skills

  • Currently enrolled at a university, ideally in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Practical experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and some familiarity with Node.js and React/Next.js. Personal projects, coursework, internships, and open-source contributions all count.
  • Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including how to structure and query data.
  • Familiarity with Git, APIs, debugging, and basic testing.
  • Interest in how systems fit together and a willingness to think through dependencies and trade-offs.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining your approach and documenting your work.
  • Initiative and follow-through: you can make progress on a defined task, use feedback, and ask for support when you need it.

Nice to Have

  • Some experience with Python, Rust, or Ruby.
  • Familiarity with caching, Redis, or event-driven systems such as Kafka.
  • First experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or Cloudflare, especially Workers, Durable Objects, or KV.
  • Exposure to Docker, GitHub Actions, or infrastructure as code.
  • Experience with AI tools, evals, reusable components, internal tools, or project templates.
  • Experience writing short technical specs or documenting design decisions.

These are useful starting points. You’ll have opportunities to learn them on the job.

Typical Stack

You won’t be expected to work with every tool from day one.

  • Languages / Frameworks: Node.js, TypeScript, React/Next.js, Python; sometimes Rust or Ruby.
  • Data: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Airflow.
  • Messaging / Streaming / Workflows: Kafka, Temporal.
  • Cloud / Edge: GCP, Azure, or AWS; we particularly like Cloudflare—Workers, Durable Objects, KV, R2, and more.
  • Infra / Tooling: Docker, GitHub Actions, IaC with Terraform.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Paid time off aligned with your working schedule, plus applicable public holidays.
  • High-end laptop, learning budget, and extensive AI tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with real products, regular feedback, and support from experienced engineers.
  • Fully remote within Germany after successful onboarding.

title: Netlify: Customer Success Associate (Denver, CO)
description: Headquarters: Remote About the Team Netlify's Customer Success team is responsible for making sure customers get real, lasting value from the platform - from onboarding through renewal and beyond. The team works closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to help customers grow their usage, see clear outcomes, and stay engaged over time. Every motion the team runs - whether it's a renewal conversation, a feature adoption push or customer escalation - is designed to build trust and relationships that compound. This role exists because we have a growing book of SMB accounts that need a dedicated, consistent point of contact. As our Customer Success Associate, you’ll drive broad-stroke outreach and build the workflows to manage them well. You'll carry a book of 120+ accounts with roughly $2M in ARR, and your job is to make sure those customers are engaged, getting value, and set up for renewal. This is an entry-level role with real ownership from day one, and you'll have mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp into the commercial side of the work. What You'll Do • Own the day-to-day relationship for your book of accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and keeping customers informed, engaged, and successful on the platform • Contribute ideas to dashboards and workflows to track your book of business - renewal timelines, health signals, engagement levels, and expansion indicators - so nothing falls through the cracks • With guidance of leadership, drive outreach to customers ahead of renewal, lead those conversations, handle objections, and negotiate terms on flat renewals and smaller expansions, looping in Sales when a meaningful expansion opportunity emerges. • Track and forecast your renewal book on a rolling basis, proactively surfacing risks and creating plans to address them before they become problems • Use product usage data and customer outcomes to demonstrate value in renewal conversations and ongoing check-ins • Identify opportunities for feature adoption and product expansion within accounts, and flag those signals to the Sales team to build expansion pipeline • Gather and synthesize customer feedback and share it with Product and internal stakeholders to inform roadmap decisions and improve the customer experience • Work closely with senior CS teammates and your manager to develop your skills in account management, commercial negotiation, and customer communication What You'll Bring • Some experience in a customer-facing role - this could be internship work, customer service, sales support, retail, or anything that required you to build rapport and solve problems for people • Comfort working with data and spreadsheets, and a genuine interest in using that data to spot trends and make decisions • A track record of following through: when you commit to something, you close the loop • Clear written and verbal communication - you can explain things simply, listen well, and adapt your approach to different audiences • An interest in building a career in customer success, and curiosity about the commercial side of the business - including how renewals work, how contracts are structured, and how value gets communicated to customers • You’re based in the Denver, Colorado area and are comfortable working remotely while participating in occasional in-person meetings and engagement with Denver-based stakeholders. This Role is a Great Fit If • You're energized by building relationships and want to be the person customers actually look forward to hearing from • You thrive when you have ownership over a defined body of work and the freedom to figure out how to make it run better • You enjoy the process of organizing complexity - tracking multiple accounts, spotting patterns, and keeping everything moving without things slipping • You're drawn to roles where you learn by doing, and you're comfortable asking questions and taking feedback as you develop your skills • You get excited about connecting customers to features or capabilities they didn't know they needed, and seeing that translate into real adoption • You work well within a team structure and are looking for mentorship, but you also want to take real ownership rather than just support someone else's book Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable. We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. title: Stage bedrijfsadministratie - office and management support
description:
Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer.

Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair Administratief Medewerker / Secretaresse krijg jij de kans om mee te draaien binnen een dynamische werkomgeving. Je ondersteunt collega's bij uiteenlopende administratieve en organisatorische werkzaamheden en zorgt ervoor dat alles achter de schermen soepel verloopt. Geen dag is hetzelfde. Je werkt samen met verschillende collega's, krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en leert hoe een professionele organisatie in de bouwsector functioneert.

Dit wordt jouw stage

Tijdens deze meewerkstage maak je onderdeel uit van het secretariaat of een ondersteuningsteam binnen Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam. Je bent een belangrijke schakel in de dagelijkse gang van zaken en helpt collega's bij het organiseren, plannen en administratief ondersteunen van hun werkzaamheden. Je krijgt de kans om verschillende werkzaamheden op te pakken en ontdekt hoe je met een goede planning, nauwkeurige administratie en sterke communicatie het verschil kunt maken binnen een organisatie.

Samen met jouw stagebegeleider kijken we welke werkzaamheden het beste aansluiten bij jouw opleiding en leerdoelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Je ondersteunt bij uiteenlopende administratieve en organisatorische werkzaamheden, zoals:

  • Het verwerken en beheren van administratieve gegevens;

  • Het plannen en organiseren van afspraken, overleggen en bijeenkomsten;

  • Het beheren van agenda's en mailboxen;

  • Het opstellen, controleren en verwerken van documenten;

  • Het ondersteunen van collega's bij diverse organisatorische werkzaamheden;

Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende teams en afdelingen.

Dit is jouw team

Je komt terecht in een betrokken en professioneel team waar samenwerken centraal staat. Collega's helpen elkaar graag en zorgen ervoor dat jij je snel thuis voelt. Tijdens jouw stage krijg je goede begeleiding en volop ruimte om nieuwe vaardigheden te ontwikkelen. Zo leer je niet alleen de praktijk kennen, maar ontdek je ook waar jouw talenten liggen.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uur per week;

  • Veel ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen;

  • Intensieve begeleiding tijdens jouw stage;

  • Een afwisselende stage met veel verantwoordelijkheid;

  • De mogelijkheid om ervaring op te doen binnen een van de grootste bouwbedrijven van Nederland;

  • De beste collega's om het vak van te leren én een fijne werksfeer.

Dit breng je mee

  • Je volgt een mbo- of hbo-opleiding in de richting van Management Assistent, Office & Management Support, Bedrijfsadministratie of vergelijkbaar;

  • Je bent nauwkeurig, georganiseerd en servicegericht;

  • Je kunt goed plannen en overzicht bewaren;

  • Je maakt makkelijk contact en communiceert prettig met collega's en externe contacten;

  • Je bent proactief en pakt werkzaamheden zelfstandig op;

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor een meewerkstage van minimaal 4 dagen per week.


Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. 

 

Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze Campus recruiter! 

Heb je nog overige vragen? Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Sanne Jonk via 06 34955966 of  

  

Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel!
